title: 随身准备包·敞口独立纸件
prompt: Create ONE isolated reusable object for a refined medical paper-theatre animation. Style: exquisite handmade fibrous cut-paper collage, gouache and fine colored-pencil shading, tactile layered paper edges, warm muted cream/teal/ochre/terracotta palette; a high-quality raster object, not a flat SVG icon. Complete object centered with comfortable empty alpha margins. Genuine RGBA transparency outside the object. No human, hands, scene, floor, backdrop, cast background halo, text, digits, brands, logos or extra objects. Subject: a small unbranded sturdy everyday teal canvas school/medical carry bag in three-quarter front view. Two short handles, open top with visible empty interior and a simple front pocket. The open rim must be clear so separate medicines, a water cup and a phone can be animated entering it later. No contents, no medical cross, no loose straps outside the object. Fibrous paper should look like painted woven fabric.
